card.name: Locally advanced or metastatic cancer
card.fires_on: The word "advanced" after "locally", and the word "metastatic" (or its start, "metast") after "advanced or", in cancer indication and dosing text. It marks the stage wording for breast, lung or gastric cancer.

modes.label: advanced after locally
modes.description: The word advanced right after "locally" in a cancer indication.
modes.example: BC locally<< advanced>> or metastatic: 60 mg

modes.label: metastatic spelled out
modes.description: The start or end of "metastatic" in a cancer stage phrase.
modes.example: For locally advanced or<< metast>>atic breast cancer after failure of prior chemotherapy
